gloss: journey, one's travels, road of travel

definitions.gloss: journey, one's travels, road of travel
definitions.explanation: The course or path of a journey. A literary term that evokes the experience and process of traveling, rather than just the destination.

examples.japanese: {長|なが}い{旅路|たびじ}に{疲|つか}れた。
examples.english: I was tired from the long journey.

examples.japanese: {旅路|たびじ}の{途中|とちゅう}で{美|うつく}しい{景色|けしき}に{出会|であ}った。
examples.english: I encountered beautiful scenery along the way.

examples.japanese: {人生|じんせい}という{旅路|たびじ}の{中|なか}で、{多|おお}くの{人|ひと}と{出会|であ}い、{別|わか}れてきた。
examples.english: Along the journey of life, I have met and parted with many people.

notes:
USAGE:
A literary and poetic word. Often used figuratively for the journey of life ({人生|じんせい}の{旅路|たびじ}). Less common in everyday speech than {旅|たび} or {旅行|りょこう}. Frequently appears in literature, poetry, and song lyrics.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {長|なが}い{旅路|たびじ}: long journey
- {旅路|たびじ}の{途中|とちゅう}: on the way, mid-journey
- {人生|じんせい}の{旅路|たびじ}: the journey of life
- {旅路|たびじ}に{就|つ}く: to set out on a journey

SIMILAR WORDS:
- {旅|たび}: trip, travel (common, everyday)
- {旅行|りょこう}: trip, travel (practical, neutral)
- {道中|どうちゅう}: en route, along the way
